messages:
maria: Heads-up — found an unwrapped partner service-account payload in partner-logs export. blob looks like a base64 token without a wrapping key ARN. tagging sec to contain.
ajay: ack. drop the object path and I9ll temp-block the partner ingest role.
maria: s3://partner-logs/2026-03-22/ingest_dump_20260322.log (around line ~842). snippet: `POST /upload 200 body={\"key\": \"eyJhbGci...\"}`
lin: if wrapping ARN is missing client-side wrap may have failed. assume plaintext until we verify ciphertext integrity. recommend immediate rewrap of any Vault secrets linked to that partner flow.
sam: +1 assume plaintext. propose immediate steps: 1) revoke partner-ingest SA decrypt perms, 2) snapshot+quarantine the object, 3) run credentials sweep for svcaccs that could have uploaded.
maria: revoked partner-ingest role permissions (iam:DetachRolePolicy). quarantined object to gs://sec-quarantine/4512345678-raw.
ajay: running quick search across recent exports: `rg --hidden --pcre "eyJ[a-z0-9_-]{10,}" /mnt/exports | head` 3: found 3 more hits in last 48h. pushing list to #sec-ops.
sec-bot: Automated: 4 potential credential artifacts flagged. Ticket created SEC-9890 assigned to eng-security.
lin: to reduce blast radius: entitlement sweep on Vault transit keys + rewrap secrets from wrap-v1 -> wrap-v2. enable audit export for transit unwraps to a readonly sink.
sam: who owns the transit keys? @infra? if partner used client-side wrap we may need to rotate consumer-side keys too.
ajay: infra pinged. infra: please run `gcloud kms keys list --locations=global --keyring=partner-wrap` and confirm rotation settings.
deploy-bot: Deployment freeze: infra key rotations paused until SEC-9890 triage completes. :no_entry_sign:
infra (webhook): partner-wrap keyring contains: wrap-v1 (rotation disabled), wrap-legacy (rotation disabled). no recent rotations.
maria: confirms stale wrap keys. mitigation plan: 1) enable rotation on wrap-v1 with daily period, 2) create wrap-v2, 3) rewrap all Vault secrets referencing wrap-v1 -> wrap-v2, 4) retire wrap-v1 and revoke external grants.
lin: rewrap job caveats: for Vault KV-v2 preserve metadata and versions (get -> transit/encrypt(new) -> put) and add concurrency limits to avoid cache storms. include SHA256 checksums before/after.
ajay: I9ll author a k8s job (cronjob) to rewrap in small batches and generate verification report (paths touched, pre/post checksums). Sam, please review RBAC PR for denying partner KMS decrypt until verification.
sam: approved provisional RBAC deny for partner-ingest-role -> kms:Decrypt until we finish verification. also approve timeline: rewrap first batch now, full sweep within 24h.
maria: running svcacc sweep now; will list accounts to rotate/revoke in SEC-9890 comments. tagging product-security and partners.
lin: add audit-forwarder rule: forward transit/unwrap events to readonly logging bucket and immutable checksum store for 90 days. helps detect any unwraps post-rotation.
ajay: ETA for batch1: ~3h. will post progress every 30m.
sec-bot: Reminder: attach label `sec:artifact` to any objects in gs://sec-quarantine.
maria: noted. if we see partner 403s, revert revoke and ping oncall immediately.
sam: action summary posted to SEC-9890: quarantine artifacts, revoke partner decrypt, enable wrap-v1 rotation, create wrap-v2, run rewrap pipeline, svcacc sweep/rotate, enable audit export.
lin: after rewrap, schedule rolling key revocation and grant-prune job. propose a short postmortem template added to ops agents.
ajay: progress update 30m: rewrap batch1 started, 42 vault paths in progress. no unwrap events observed in audit sink so far.
maria: nice. keep cadence. :thumbsup:
ajay: progress update 2h: batch1 completed, 42 paths rewrapped successfully, checksums match verification. launching batch2 (next 150 paths).
infra: wrap-v2 created. rotation enabled on wrap-v1 with 24h period. external grants on wrap-v1 revoked (pending verification).
lin: reminder: retain rewrap verification logs in secure retention for audit (attach to SEC-9890).
maria: thanks everyone 3 closing loop in SEC-9890 with checklist items and owners."
